arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python -c "
from rich.highlighter import ReprHighlighter
from rich.text import Text
t=Text('https://example.org/~user/x'); ReprHighlighter().highlight(t); print(t.spans)"

turns.reply: The URL highlighting regex in `rich/highlighter.py` now accepts `~`, so `https://example.org/~user/x` is highlighted as a single `repr.url` span. I checked this with a one-off script; I did not run the repository's test files, and the patch is submitted.
